# Status Rollup

PROVIDES a deterministic rollup of child node test results
SO THAT the spec-tree status surface and CI
CAN report a parent node's state from its descendants

The rollup folds each child state into the parent state.

# Status Rollup

PROVIDES a deterministic rollup of child node test results
SO THAT the spec-tree status surface and CI report a parent's state

## Assertions

### Scenarios

- Given a tree with one failing child, when status is computed, then the parent reports failing ([test](tests/test_status.scenario.l1.py))

# Status Rollup

PROVIDES a deterministic rollup of child node test results
SO THAT the spec-tree status surface and CI
CAN report a parent node's state from its descendants

- Given a tree with one failing child, when status is computed, then the parent reports failing ([test](tests/test_status.scenario.l1.py))

- Status rollup is deterministic: the same tree always produces the same status ([test](tests/test_status.property.l1.py))
